AD_COLUMN.NAME: Analytics Sync
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Primary key of the analytics synchronization state record.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: A unique identifier for each synchronization state entry, generated by the system.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Log
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Text with the log info
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Text with all the logging information

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Creation Date
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: The date that this record is completed.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Created field indicates the date that this record was created.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Organization
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Organizational entity within client
AD_COLUMN.HELP: An organization is a unit of your client or legal entity - examples are store, department. You can share data between organizations.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Client
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Client for this installation.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: A Client is a company or a legal entity. You cannot share data between Clients.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Active
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: A flag indicating whether this record is available for use or de-activated.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reporting. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for auditing purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are existing invoices for it. By de-activating the Business Partner you prevent it from being used in future transactions.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Analytics Exporter Config
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Primary key of the analytics exporter configuration record.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: A unique identifier for each analytics exporter configuration record.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Updated
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: The date that this record was last updated
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Updated field indicates the date that this record was updated.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Created By
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: User who created this records
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Created By field indicates the user who created this record.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Last Sync
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of the last successful data synchronization.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Stores the date and time of the most recent successful export. This value is used as a reference point for incremental data extraction.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Last Job
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the last export job accepted by the receiver.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Stores the job identifier returned by the external receiver when the export request was accepted. Used for traceability and diagnostics.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Updated By
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: User who updated this records
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Updated By field indicates the user who updated this record.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Creation Date
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: The date that this record is completed.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Created field indicates the date that this record was created.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Active
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: A flag indicating whether this record is available for use or de-activated.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reporting. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for auditing purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are existing invoices for it. By de-activating the Business Partner you prevent it from being used in future transactions.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Configuration Name
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Name of the analytics exporter configuration record.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Use a descriptive name such as Default System Configuration.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Chunk Days
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Number of days included in each session and usage audit export chunk.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Smaller chunks reduce payload size and make retries safer for high-volume customers.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Client
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Client for this installation.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: A Client is a company or a legal entity. You cannot share data between Clients.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Created By
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: User who created this records
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Created By field indicates the user who created this record.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Connect Timeout Ms
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Connection timeout in milliseconds for sender HTTP calls.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: How long the sender waits to establish the HTTP connection to the receiver.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Detailed Logging Enabled
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Enables extra per-chunk sender diagnostics in process and application logs.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: When enabled, the sender writes richer operational details for each transmitted chunk.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Initial Export Days
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Number of days included when there is no previous successful synchronization.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Controls bootstrap size for the first session and usage audit synchronization.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Organization
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Organizational entity within client
AD_COLUMN.HELP: An organization is a unit of your client or legal entity - examples are store, department. You can share data between organizations.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Receiver URL
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: HTTP endpoint used by the sender to deliver analytics payloads.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Points to the analytics receiver process endpoint that accepts exported payloads.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Read Timeout Ms
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Read timeout in milliseconds for sender HTTP calls.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: How long the sender waits for the receiver response after the request is sent.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Max Retries
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of HTTP retry attempts for payload delivery.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Applies to retryable sender errors such as transient network failures and 5xx responses.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Updated
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: The date that this record was last updated
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Updated field indicates the date that this record was updated.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Last Status
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Status of the last export execution.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Indicates the result of the most recent export attempt, such as SUCCESS or FAILED.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Updated By
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: User who updated this records
AD_COLUMN.HELP: The Updated By field indicates the user who updated this record.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Retry Delay Ms
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Delay in milliseconds between retry attempts.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Controls how long the sender waits before retrying a failed HTTP delivery attempt.

AD_COLUMN.NAME: Sync Type
AD_COLUMN.DESCRIPTION: Type of analytics export tracked by this synchronization state.
AD_COLUMN.HELP: Defines the category of data being synchronized, such as sessions, usage audits, or module metadata. This allows independent tracking of multiple export flows.
